{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"First few order_ids of QA orders: {qa_orders['order_id'].tolist()[:3]}")

# Check if they are refunded or completed
print(f"Status of QA orders: {qa_orders['status'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check if they are in the conversion count
print(f"Converted status of QA orders: {qa_orders['converted'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
